acceptance: finite full write, inputs unchanged, fresh tensors per trial, and the relative-L2 / elementwise rule on every case, edge fixtures included

reference.arithmetic: fp32 chunked selective-state-space recurrence with the state carried in fp32

tolerances.rule: an element passes when |diff| <= scaled_abs*scale or |diff| <= rel*denominator; the verdict is the violation count plus the relative L2 against rel_l2
